findings_addressed: Headline spacing loosened after viewing the first render; the reference's overall style is retained.
No video examples, operator-console hero, fake execution log or generation-review ledger in the active homepage/collection.
Six imported static files are unique native-size assets from the owner's existing public reference, not new high-resolution Canva exports.
Residential-cleaning pieces are own-brand direct-mail work, not claimed as paid social campaigns or client performance evidence.
The CareLine comparison is product-explainer creative, not a claim that this public demo booked an appointment.
Printed offer terms remain on the artwork. Portfolio presentation does not renew or strengthen those historical offers.
scope_limits: No physical iPhone test or actual telephone call was performed.
No CRM configuration, booking or message was changed or triggered.
Existing client creative and case studies were retained from the reviewed public estate; this release did not re-audit every original campaign asset.
The broad Canva inventory has not been newly exported or exhausted.
The browser report was emitted before this manual inspection and records that timing as pending; this separate record completes the selected visual review.
decision: Accept this creative-first presentation for the user-authorized release. Technical and live-publication checks remain separate.
